approval_ref: Continue improving CIRP efficiency, accuracy and adaptability across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
notes: Reproduce an RFI answer borrowing an alphabetic revision label from another RFI in one citation.
Validate explicitly written Revision/Rev labels as atomic values before generic numeric checks.
Keep a claimed revision with the same exact RFI/Submittal identity or source finding.
Normalize prefix punctuation and case only; keep label values exact.
Do not treat revision dates, unlabelled words or evidence metadata alone as revision-label claims, and do not infer chronology or authority.
title: Ground project-answer revision labels
objective: Prevent an explicit revision label from being recombined or borrowed across workflows or source findings in a project-file answer.
